claims.text: Many reviewers say the bracket creates breathing room and keeps the mask off their mouth and face.
Several reviewers report the bracket slips down or moves when talking, exposing the nose or requiring constant readjustment.
A common complaint is that the bracket traps heat and makes the wearer hot or sweaty.
Some reviewers say it keeps makeup off the mask and is easy to clean.
Several reviewers find it too small for adults, better suited to children or small faces, and question the material quality.

qa.q: Is it comfortable to wear for long periods?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on long-term comfort: one reviewer says it is super comfortable and helps if you have to wear it all day [3], while another found it awkward on day one [1] and another said heat from breath made it too uncomfortable to wear [4]. A fourth reviewer was unsure how comfortable it would be worn directly on the face for many hours [2].

qa.answer: Reviews disagree on safety: one reviewer says it is "not safe at all" because the mask moves down and exposes your nose [2], while others describe it positively without raising safety concerns [1][5]. No review directly mentions a smell.

qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: one calls it "worth every penny" [1], but others call it a "waste of money" [4] and say not to buy [6]. One reviewer also received only 4 pieces despite a 5-piece label [2].
